name: Hirudinaria granulosa – Nervous System
description:
This 3D model shows the nervous system of the Indian cattle leech (Hirudinaria granulosa), a member of Phylum Annelida. The system is simple, ladder-like, and segmentally organized, adapted for coordinated movement and sensory response.

It consists of a pair of anterior cerebral ganglia (brain) connected to a double ventral nerve cord. Along the nerve cord, a series of segmental ganglia are present, each controlling specific body segments.

The leech also has sensory receptors for detecting touch, vibrations, and environmental changes.

This model is useful for studying annelid neuroanatomy, segmental organization, and basic nervous coordination.
